text.text_excerpt: This is where I would stay every week while working in New Orleans if I weren't stocking up on hotel points to use for a summer vacation. The concierge was friendly (but not overly so in a fake way) and greeted me by name every time I came through the lobby. Even the off-duty concierge addressed me by name. Kind of makes you feel important. The room, like the lobby, is chic and sleek with poured concrete floors (unexpectedly warm to your feet!) and a theme of refurbished wood. Beds are firm and low to the ground with nice flat screens and an iPod speaker system, surrounding you with a great way to fall, and stay, asleep. STAYCATION! I enjoy staying downtown during the summer months. Its a great time to get a really swanky hotel room at a really good price. This was my second time staying here, and I was very pleased. The front desk clerk gave me a room towards the back of the hotel to avoid hearing the 5am garbage truck. He must have sensed that i am no good before 7am. Lol. This small boutique hotel is in a great location..walking distance to eateries and bars. I love the room decor and huge bathrooms. The tub is fantastic. Bed was comfy and the room is nicely furnished. The room had a small fridge and the robes and slippers were a nice touch. To my fellow New Orleanians...make it a point to treat yourse...

This is a great hotel. The location is pretty good, but the street is busy and one way so it can be hard to get in and out with the car. The valet isn't particularly quick either. The first couple nights they were filming in the bar so that caused some inconvenience, but not enough to really bother us. The rooms are clean, and the limited furniture and tall ceilings make if modern and give it s spacious feel. I particularly love the Aveda products in the bathroom. It's a nice hotel with a nice staff and a great price and location. I'd recommend it to anyone who doesn't want to stay directly in the Quarter but wants to be close to the hub.
